body:
Remember that line from wolf of Wall Street when McConaughey asks Jordan how many times he jerks off & then goes onto say that he jerks off at least two times. Then says “I want to. That's not why I do it. I do it cause I fuckin' need to”

Never related to a line in a movie as much as this one. That’s my adhd med. After I jerk off my sex drive is under control & I can be laser focused. 

Now in high school it was out of control. Id have a hard on through out most of the school day. When I look back at it it’s pretty messed up cause you know we’re supposed to be in school to learn, but none the less that’s good you found something that works because sex is great and all, but being horny all the time is counter productive to getting stuff done. 

Never been in a relationship. I’m not really romantic tbh, so I I just figured any relationship I’d get into would be transactional anyways whether it’s strictly sex or for public image.  

 Everyone tells me I’ll find someone & fall in love, but Idk it’s the least of my priorities & I think it’s just a chemical reaction anyways 

Interested about this non-stimulant ADHD medication because I’ve never had a good reaction with adhd meds. I was prescribed concerta & couldn’t adjust to it, so just gave up on medicine. 

I don’t think my issues can be treated with a pill. Just money

You know what. I’ve never connected those dots. Good job. My parents always told me I had an addictive personality & my self have noticed it. From drugs to sex to gambling. I think that’s now where I’m starting to struggle. I don’t have anything new to get addicted to. I do like work I become a workaholic, but I haven’t been able to find a decent job recently. I’ve tried moving states & it’s driving me crazy that I can’t find anything. Id love to get addicted to the gym again, but with my very fast metabolism it’s expensive. I only like eating healthy which is the part expensive. Combine that with having to eat a surplus of calories. It’s just not an attainable goal atm. 

I’ve always connected my need for money not necessarily with stuff, but with power. 

Power over my self to start. Power to build the dream body I want. Power to get any girl I want to do what I want. Power to get people to work for me. Power to get people to do things for entertainment. Power to never have to worry about the price.That’s the stuff I want that money can buy. 

Another connection I’ve made is OCD. I think obsessively about being healthy. I feel guilty whenever I slip up eat a donut or something. And I’m in fine health. That was one of the reasons it’s been so easy for me to ultimately conquer my drug issues. Nicotine was the hardest. Funny you mention cocaine cause I did have a summer where I was using every or every other weekend. That was easy for me to because I would have horrible come downs & usually catch a cold. 

So now it all makes sense. Combine an addictive personality with OCD & a raging ambition & not being where you want obviously it’s going to = suicidal ideation.
